dim_256_vs_canonical.verdict: d=256 offers NO net benefit; single-seed 'win' was favorable seed variance. Only Spearman rho shows a real (non-overlapping) difference, and it FAVORS d=128 (0.5553 vs 0.5486). KEEP d=128.

temp_0.05_vs_canonical.verdict: tau=0.05 offers NO net benefit, same pattern as dim_256. KEEP tau=0.07.

ablations_8config.note_for_manuscript: Original manuscript's stated justification numbers for tau=0.07/d=128 (specific NDCG values, 'catastrophic' d=256 framing) were measured under the buggy checkpoint-selection code and are factually wrong under the corrected model. The CONCLUSION (keep tau=0.07, d=128) is unchanged and is now MORE robustly supported (survived adversarial 3-seed replication of the two configs that looked like they might beat it).

generative_multiseed_5seed.bimodal_rl_landscape_finding: DOES NOT REPRODUCE (confirmed twice independently, both under the fully corrected checkpoint). CRAVE-filtered oscc_potency per seed lands in a continuous band 0.715-0.796 (mean 0.771+/-0.033) -- no split into a high-basin (~0.897, 3/5 seeds) and low-basin (~0.713, 2/5 seeds) as originally published. This headline claim is DROPPED from the fresh manuscript per user decision (2026-09-17); report the honest continuous-band finding instead.

table2_pairwise_stats_FRESH_and_brute_fo.method: One-sided Mann-Whitney U (H1: CRAVE-filtered > comparator), n1=n2=5, computed directly from the 5-seed oscc_potency values above. Exact p-value for U=25 (complete separation) independently brute-force verified by enumerating all C(10,5)=252 possible rank arrangements: only 1 gives complete separation -> p=1/252=0.003968.
table2_pairwise_stats_FRESH_and_brute_fo.note: CORRECTS an earlier (wrong) session note that claimed the exact p for U=25 at n=5v5 was 0.0383 (not significant after Bonferroni) -- that was itself an error, disproven by brute-force enumeration. The originally published manuscript's Table 2 claim (significant for VAE/cVAE/CGLF, not for RL-VAE) is CORRECT and is what the fresh manuscript should state, using these freshly-computed U/p values.

phase4_bioactivity_profiling.safety_collapse_finding: Published (Run 1, Mar 2026): PASS=3294/6998=47.1%. This run: PASS=1025/7000=14.6%. CONFIRMED independent of the checkpoint-selection bug (near-identical 15.1% pre-fix vs 14.6% post-fix) -- a genuine, robust EGFR/aniline-toxicophore generative bias (aniline alone flags 48.4% of molecules; nearly all top-scoring generated molecules are EGFR-targeting aniline-quinazoline scaffolds, reflecting the training data's 28.9% EGFR skew). Per user decision (2026-09-17): report honestly as a Results finding + Discussion/Limitations item.
